notes.manifest: Rebuilt twice on 2026-09-30: research/feed/watch.py checkpoint from the feed clone's git objects reproduced checkpoints/2026-09-29.json byte for byte, and an independent walk of the extracted tree (git archive, case-sensitive directory) gave the same digest over 171308 files.
notes.ots: Not verified against Bitcoin: no node was available, and ots-client 0.7 does not start on Windows. The proof was parsed with the opentimestamps library: it commits to the SHA-256 of the checkpoint file and carries a Bitcoin block header attestation at height 969122, Merkle root 4d5546f12e4e4f163b486bd532437d8cc5565af464ad04cc9eab710573cca38a. That root has not been compared with the block.
notes.sigstore: Bundle present; cosign was not available, so it was not checked.
notes.extraction: The commit holds paths that differ only in case (state/remote__io.github.Zuga-luga__Zugabot.json and ...__zugabot.json). On a case-insensitive filesystem one of each pair is lost, so the snapshot tree must be extracted into a case-sensitive directory.

hosted watched pct.definition: Hosted endpoints' share of the watchlist. As a percentage, one decimal.

watchlist synced.definition: The date the watchlist was last rebuilt from the registry.

hosted state files.definition: Hosted servers the feed holds a state file for, including ones since dropped from the watchlist.

read and current.definition: Hosted state files with a catalogue and no failed attempt since.

read and current pct.definition: Read and current, of all hosted state files. As a percentage, one decimal.

catalogue but latest failed.definition: Hosted state files with a catalogue whose latest reading attempt failed.

catalogue but latest failed pct.definition: The same, of all hosted state files. As a percentage, one decimal.

never read.definition: Hosted state files with no catalogue: never read.

never read pct.definition: Never read, of all hosted state files. As a percentage, one decimal.

never read by reason.definition: Never read, by the recorded reason (attempted.why).

never read: login or payment.definition: Never read, reason grouped as login or payment.

never read: login or payment pct.definition: Never read for login or payment, of all hosted state files. As a percentage, one decimal.

never read: not found.definition: Never read, reason grouped as not found.

never read: not found pct.definition: Never read for not found, of all hosted state files. As a percentage, one decimal.

never read: other 4xx.definition: Never read, reason grouped as other 4xx.

never read: other 4xx pct.definition: Never read for other 4xx, of all hosted state files. As a percentage, one decimal.

never read: 5xx pct.definition: Never read for 5xx, of all hosted state files. As a percentage, one decimal.

never read: network error.definition: Never read, reason grouped as network error.

never read: network error pct.definition: Never read for network error, of all hosted state files. As a percentage, one decimal.

never read: protocol.definition: Never read, reason grouped as protocol.

never read: protocol pct.definition: Never read for protocol, of all hosted state files. As a percentage, one decimal.

never read: other.definition: Never read, reason grouped as other.

never read: other pct.definition: Never read for other, of all hosted state files. As a percentage, one decimal.

events.definition: Every change event in the snapshot's events/*.jsonl.

npm events seeded.definition: npm events carried in from the churn study (`seeded`), not observed by the feed.

live events.definition: Every event the feed observed (not seeded).

live window start.definition: The earliest observed_at among observed events.

live window end.definition: The latest observed_at among observed events.

live events per UTC day.definition: Observed events by the UTC date of observed_at.

live hosted events per UTC day.definition: Observed hosted events by the UTC date of observed_at.

live events per UTC day without top thre.definition: The same, leaving out the three operators with the most hosted events.

busiest hosted day.definition: The UTC date with the most observed hosted events.

busiest hosted day events.definition: Observed hosted events on that date.

substantive.definition: Events of kind substantive (research/feed/operators.py: an event is substantive if a tool was added, removed or changed in substance).

numbers-only.definition: Events of kind numbers-only (research/feed/operators.py: an event is substantive if a tool was added, removed or changed in substance).

reorder-only.definition: Events of kind reorder-only (research/feed/operators.py: an event is substantive if a tool was added, removed or changed in substance).

unclassified.definition: Events of kind unclassified (research/feed/operators.py: an event is substantive if a tool was added, removed or changed in substance).

recomputed kinds.definition: The kinds recomputed from both catalogues of every event with research/feed/operators.py.

operators.definition: Distinct operators over every event: a hosted server's registrable domain, an npm package's name (approximate; see stats.json `grouping`).

top 1 operator.definition: The operator with the 1. most hosted events.

top 1 events of hosted pct.definition: pipeworx.io's share of hosted events. As a percentage, one decimal.

top 1 events of all pct.definition: pipeworx.io's share of all events. As a percentage, one decimal.

top 1 events changing each field.definition: pipeworx.io's events in which a changed tool's field moved, per field (one event counts once per field).

top 1 servers.definition: Distinct hosted servers of pipeworx.io with an event.

top 1 whole-catalogue events.definition: pipeworx.io's events marked whole_catalogue (every tool changed at once).

top 1 whole-catalogue events pct.definition: The same, of the operator's hosted events. As a percentage, one decimal.

top 2 operator.definition: The operator with the 2. most hosted events.

top 2 events of hosted pct.definition: nolimit-observatory.workers.dev's share of hosted events. As a percentage, one decimal.

top 2 events of all pct.definition: nolimit-observatory.workers.dev's share of all events. As a percentage, one decimal.

top 2 events changing each field.definition: nolimit-observatory.workers.dev's events in which a changed tool's field moved, per field (one event counts once per field).

top 2 servers.definition: Distinct hosted servers of nolimit-observatory.workers.dev with an event.

top 2 whole-catalogue events.definition: nolimit-observatory.workers.dev's events marked whole_catalogue (every tool changed at once).

top 2 whole-catalogue events pct.definition: The same, of the operator's hosted events. As a percentage, one decimal.

top 3 operator.definition: The operator with the 3. most hosted events.

top 3 events of hosted pct.definition: a2awire.com's share of hosted events. As a percentage, one decimal.

top 3 events of all pct.definition: a2awire.com's share of all events. As a percentage, one decimal.

top 3 events changing each field.definition: a2awire.com's events in which a changed tool's field moved, per field (one event counts once per field).

top 3 servers.definition: Distinct hosted servers of a2awire.com with an event.

top 3 whole-catalogue events.definition: a2awire.com's events marked whole_catalogue (every tool changed at once).

top 3 whole-catalogue events pct.definition: The same, of the operator's hosted events. As a percentage, one decimal.

top three events.definition: Hosted events of the top three operators together.

top three of hosted pct.definition: The top three's share of hosted events. As a percentage, one decimal.

top three of all pct.definition: The top three's share of all events. As a percentage, one decimal.

hosted servers changed.definition: Distinct hosted servers with at least one event.

median changes per changed hosted server.definition: The median number of events per hosted server with at least one.

hosted servers with exactly one change.definition: Hosted servers with exactly one event.

changes per changed hosted server.definition: Hosted servers with at least one event, by how many they had.

hosted events outside top three.definition: Hosted events of every other operator.

hosted servers outside top three.definition: Distinct hosted servers with an event, outside the top three operators.

review.definition: Events the collector graded review: a change introduced a signal (heldfast.driftgrade).

review by introduced kind.definition: Review events per kind of signal introduced; an event with several kinds counts once under each.

price review events.definition: Review events that introduced a price.

price review servers.definition: Distinct servers with such an event.

first price review.definition: The earliest observed_at of a review event that introduced a price.

review without price.definition: Review events that introduced no price; each is listed in research/report/review-events.md.

servers with a stated price changed.definition: Servers with an observed event in which a stated price was changed (amounts found by heldfast.driftgrade's price patterns, per unit, in the description, title and schema text of a changed or added tool). A stated amount can be an example rather than the server's charge.

servers with a stated price added to a t.definition: Servers with an observed event in which a stated price was added to a tool (amounts found by heldfast.driftgrade's price patterns, per unit, in the description, title and schema text of a changed or added tool). A stated amount can be an example rather than the server's charge.

servers with a stated price removed from.definition: Servers with an observed event in which a stated price was removed from a tool (amounts found by heldfast.driftgrade's price patterns, per unit, in the description, title and schema text of a changed or added tool). A stated amount can be an example rather than the server's charge.

servers with a stated price on a new too.definition: Servers with an observed event in which a stated price was on a new tool (amounts found by heldfast.driftgrade's price patterns, per unit, in the description, title and schema text of a changed or added tool). A stated amount can be an example rather than the server's charge.

servers with a readable price change.definition: Servers with at least one tool whose single stated price in a unit became a different single price in that unit.

readable price pairs.definition: Such before-and-after pairs, per tool and event, over every server.

servers by direction.definition: Servers with a readable change, by whether every pair rose, every pair fell, or both.

server with most pairs.definition: The server carrying the most readable pairs.

pairs on that server pct.definition: That server's share of all readable pairs. As a percentage, one decimal.

most servers with a stated price changed.definition: The largest number of servers with a stated price changed (as above) within any 4 consecutive UTC days.

that four-day window starts.definition: The first day of that window.

most servers with a readable price chang.definition: The same, counting only readable changes (one price became another).

that readable four-day window starts.definition: The first day of that window.

servers with a price at least tripled.definition: Servers with a readable pair whose new price is three or more times the old.

claim of 23 servers in four days reprodu.definition: Whether at least 23 servers had a readable price change within four days and at least one price at least tripled. Counting any change in stated amounts instead is the figure two above.

distinct definitions.definition: Entries in lookup/all.json: distinct tool definitions the log has recorded.

definitions on exactly one server.definition: Of those, the ones recorded on exactly one server.

checkpoints.definition: Checkpoints in the snapshot tree, with the files each has (.json, .json.ots, .json.sigstore.json). The snapshot's own checkpoint is written after its commit, so it is not in its tree.

packages.definition: Churn study, third-party servers: packages, from analyse.py rerun (or suspicious.json, which needs results/ that are not committed to rerun).

release pairs.definition: Churn study, third-party servers: release pairs, from analyse.py rerun (or suspicious.json, which needs results/ that are not committed to rerun).

description edits.definition: Churn study, third-party servers: description edits, from analyse.py rerun (or suspicious.json, which needs results/ that are not committed to rerun).

introduced anything.definition: Churn study, third-party servers: introduced anything, from analyse.py rerun (or suspicious.json, which needs results/ that are not committed to rerun).

above 0.5.definition: Churn study, third-party servers: above 0.5, from analyse.py rerun (or suspicious.json, which needs results/ that are not committed to rerun).

above 0.5 releases.definition: Churn study, third-party servers: above 0.5 releases, from analyse.py rerun (or suspicious.json, which needs results/ that are not committed to rerun).

matches docs/CHURN.md.definition: Whether every figure above equals the one docs/CHURN.md states.
